list.name: log_group
list.label: 로그 그룹
list.description: Nginx 액세스 로그가 저장된 CloudWatch 로그 그룹 이름

list.name: geo_log_group
list.label: GeoIP 로그 그룹
list.description: Lambda가 GeoIP 필드를 추가해 기록하는 로그 그룹

panels.title: 웹 공격 패턴 탐지 추이

targets.expression:
fields request_uri like /(?i)(union(%20|\+|\s)+select|or(%20|\+|\s)+1=1|%27|sleep\(|benchmark\()/ as sqli, request_uri like /(?i)(<script|%3Cscript|javascript:|onerror=|%3Ciframe)/ as xss, request_uri like /(?i)(\.\.\/|\.\.%2f|%2e%2e|%252e)/ as traversal, request_uri like /(?i)(;|%3B|\||%7C)(cat|ls|id|whoami|wget|curl)/ as cmdi
| stats sum(sqli) as SQLi, sum(xss) as XSS, sum(traversal) as Traversal, sum(cmdi) as CMDi by bin(5m)

panels.description: URL(request_uri) 기반 탐지입니다. POST body로 들어오는 공격은 액세스 로그에 남지 않습니다.

targets.expression:
filter request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/
| stats count(*) as suspicious

fields @timestamp, ip, method, request_uri, status, user_agent
| filter request_uri like /(?i)(union.*select|%27|<script|%3Cscript|\.\.\/|%2e%2e|onerror=)/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

filter path = "/rest/user/login" and method = "POST"
| fields (status = 401) as failed
| stats sum(failed) as login_fail by bin(1m), ip

filter user_agent like /(?i)(sqlmap|nikto|nmap|gobuster|dirbuster|ffuf|wfuzz|burp|zap|nuclei|masscan|python-requests|curl|wget)/
| stats count(*) as req, count_distinct(path) as paths by ip, user_agent
| sort req desc

filter path like /(?i)^\/(ftp|encryptionkeys|support\/logs|metrics|api-docs|\.git|\.env|administration|rest\/admin|api\/Users|b2b)/
| stats count(*) as cnt, latest(@timestamp) as last_seen by ip, path, status
| sort cnt desc

filter status = 404
| stats count(*) as not_found, count_distinct(path) as unique_paths by ip, bin(5m)
| filter unique_paths > 20
| sort not_found desc

panels.title: IP별 요청 폭주 (분당 300건 초과)

targets.expression:
stats count(*) as req by ip, bin(1m)
| filter req > 300
| sort req desc

panels.description: Socket.IO polling은 평소에도 분당 수십 건 발생하므로 임계값은 평소 트래픽을 보고 조정하세요.
